description: This Java source file defines the `ShipmentServices` class, which provides various service methods related to shipment operations in the OFBiz framework. The methods include creating and removing shipment estimates, calculating shipment costs, filling staging tables, updating shipments from staging, handling shipment notifications, duplicating shipment route segments, scheduling shipments asynchronously, calculating shipment package values, and retrieving shipment gateway configurations. The file interacts heavily with the OFBiz entity engine, service engine, and utility classes, and manages shipment lifecycle and logistics operations.

classes.name: ShipmentServices
classes.description: This class provides static service methods for handling shipments within the OFBiz framework, including cost estimation, staging, notifications, and route management.

methods.name: createShipmentEstimate
methods.description: Creates a shipment cost estimate based on provided parameters and shipment method configuration.

methods.name: removeShipmentEstimate
methods.description: Removes an existing shipment cost estimate identified by its ID.

methods.name: calcShipmentCostEstimate
methods.description: Calculates the total shipping cost estimate using various criteria such as address, weight, quantity, and rate tables.

methods.name: fillShipmentStagingTables
methods.description: Populates staging tables with shipment data for further processing or external systems integration.

methods.name: updateShipmentsFromStaging
methods.description: Updates shipments and associated packages based on staging data, including tracking info and status.

methods.name: clearShipmentStagingInfo
methods.description: Clears staging data related to a specified shipment.

methods.name: updatePurchaseShipmentFromReceipt
methods.description: Checks shipment receipts and updates shipment statuses accordingly if all items are received.

methods.name: duplicateShipmentRouteSegment
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing shipment route segment with the same configuration.

methods.name: quickScheduleShipmentRouteSegment
methods.description: Asynchronously schedules a shipment route segment, optionally confirming shipment with the carrier.

methods.name: getShipmentPackageValueFromOrders
methods.description: Calculates the total value of a shipment package by aggregating invoice amounts prorated from OrderItems.

methods.name: sendShipmentCompleteNotification
methods.description: Sends an email notification upon shipment completion, including tracking and order details.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigFromShipment
methods.description: Retrieves shipment gateway configuration details based on shipment and order data.
